paper.title_en: Shadow of rotating black hole surrounded by dark matter
paper.abstract_en: Dark matter (DM), a fundamental cosmic component, motivates the study of its influence on black hole (BH) shadows, especially for spinning BHs confirmed by EHT observations. This work generalizes the Schwarzschild BH surrounded by DM to an axisymmetric Kerr BH using the Newman-Janis Algorithm (NJA), investigating the resulting event horizon and ergosphere structures. Employing null geodesics, we examine the effects of DM mass $ΔM$ on BH shadow, including its radius, distortion, and the associated energy emission rate. Our analysis reveals that DM has a negligible effect below a critical mass, once this threshold is surpassed, all BH structures expand significantly. Furthermore, DM robustly contributes to the shadow maintaining a near circular shape, even for highly spinning BHs. This pronounced structural expansion under high DM mass may potentially exceed current observational constraints, suggesting that DM must either be absent in the immediate vicinity of the BH or its localized mass must remain below this critical value to be consistent with astrophysical observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将暗物质笼罩的 Schwarzschild 黑洞通过 Newman-Janis 算法推广到旋转 Kerr 情形，并系统分析事件视界、能层结构、零测地线、阴影半径、畸变以及能量发射率；选题与静态学术索引中的广义相对论基础方向高度相关，方法链条清楚，给出临界暗物质质量这一可检验的结构性结论。虽以既有框架为主、理论创新有限，且缺少同行评议验证，但值得研究者点击阅读以评估其与观测约束的一致性。
decision.title_zh: 暗物质包围的旋转黑洞的阴影
decision.abstract_zh: 暗物质（DM）作为基本的宇宙组分，促使人们研究其对黑洞（BH）阴影的影响，尤其对于经 EHT 观测所确认的旋转黑洞而言。本工作使用 Newman-Janis 算法（NJA）将暗物质包围的 Schwarzschild 黑洞推广为轴对称的 Kerr 黑洞，并研究由此产生的事件视界与能层结构。我们借助零测地线，考察暗物质质量 $\Delta M$ 对黑洞阴影的影响，包括其半径、畸变以及相关的能量发射率。我们的分析表明，在临界质量以下，暗物质的影响可以忽略不计；一旦超过该阈值，所有黑洞结构都会显著扩张。此外，暗物质有力地促使阴影即使对于高自旋黑洞也保持接近圆形的形状。在高暗物质质量下这种显著的结构扩张可能超出当前的观测限制，这暗示着为了使结果与天体物理观测保持一致，暗物质要么必须不存在于黑洞紧邻区域，要么其局域质量必须保持在该临界值以下。
